Implementation gate: compile and execute with the pooled reference hash and confirm its family weights reach the teacher prior while teacher coordinates/branch modes stay R04-identical; if absent, report a no-op rather than efficacy. This is a test of less luck-sensitive prior credit, not a promised affinity improvement; retain historical R11 if paired affinity, strain, or validity regress.

Retain R11 as fallback. derivation.rationale: R09 is one prior-credit calibration: preserve the R08 teacher points, family-first ranking, instantaneous branch fields, endpoint_branch_mixture formula, final-family mean semantics and every numeric guidance parameter; substitute only the bound family_tail025_v1 prior library (SHA-256 4e87a04501c1aed3ac09786ba3da492b2cfc46f3fdef183cf5e5549d299fb10d), reducing the observed-tail coefficient from 0.5 to 0.25 (updates={}). The executed family_tail025_v1 calculator receipt is 19bb5b087cfe9d15ad12be6e0efc4a1d98e4afa7355f13db721b7c09f5e1d964. It starts from the R06 mean library to avoid double-crediting; therefore its reported batch-equal utility delta 0.0172715, compared with 0.0345430 at 0.5, is a calculator contrast versus the R06 source, not a measured R09-vs-R08 rollout change. The formula uses decoded-final graph-aware mean plus 0.25 times observed high-affinity offspring fraction at threshold pIC50 >= 8.258901977539063. Denominator is every observed terminal offspring slot in the exact-copy family, including invalid decoded offspring; validity is tracked separately. In the source diagnostic 398/1,203 teacher records across 14 batches had nonzero tail fraction (median 0; p75 0.0731707; max 1); six batches had zero observed tail credit. The added term is an uncalibrated heuristic utility, not pIC50 or native-success probability, and it never selects a maximum child. Calculator teacher coordinates remain unchanged. Keep label clock 1.0, score support [0,0.5], state control through 0.51, native continuation beyond, and the existing FLOWR endpoint VJP/Jacobian path. R08 prospective outcomes were mixed versus R06 (+0.072355 and -0.044485; mean +0.013935) despite positive versus native in both batches, with p90 strain 1.79411; these are reasons to test a smaller tail term, not evidence it will help. Before interpreting efficacy, verify exact instruction and reference binding, compiled prior fields, fresh actual FLOWR VJP and full generation response; compare affinity, validity and strain prospectively. Keep R06 as quality fallback.
